﻿Call of Duty - MW4 DMZ Intel Briefing Clipping
TikTok, Instagram Reels
Launch date: Nov 6, 2026
✔ You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
 WHAT TO DO
Clip the DMZ Intel Briefing video from the official content folder.
Show the new DMZ content in Modern Warfare 4 Season 1.
Post to TikTok and Instagram Reels.
Content folder: https://app.mediasilo.com/review/6aee70ddb93f5a144f86aadf
	

⚠️ Use only footage from the official content folder. Outside footage is rejected.
	 CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✔ Tag @callofduty (TikTok and Instagram)
✔ Disclosure hashtag (see FTC DISCLOSURE below)
@callofduty
	YOUR CHOICE
* Use one of the captions below, or write your own close to them.
* Make the caption match the clip.
EXAMPLES
* New MW4 DMZ BlackSite XO1 Looks Insane @callofduty
#Ad
* DMZ Gets a Big Update in MW4 Season 1 @callofduty
#Ad
* DMZ is Free to play until November 11th @callofduty
#Ad
NOTE
   * Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
   * Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
   * Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
 FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post MUST include one of these in the caption:
#Ad     #Advertisement     #Sponsored
	

   * Put it on its own line, right after the caption text.
   * It must be the first hashtag.
   * Up to 3 more hashtags are allowed. They must relate to the content.
   * Same font, size, and color as the rest of the caption.
 FREE TRIAL MENTION (REQUIRED)
Every post must mention the DMZ Free Trial.
Put it in the caption or the on-screen text.
Use one of these lines:
   * DMZ is Free to play until November 11th
   * DMZ gets free access for a limited time
	 ON-SCREEN TEXT (OPTIONAL)
   * On-screen text is optional, unless it carries the free trial line.
   * If you add it, it must match what is on screen.
   * Keep it short, clear, and easy to read.
EXAMPLES
   * The DMZ intel briefing for MW4 Season 1
   * New DMZ location in Season 1: X01
   * Ghost briefs the squad on X01
Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
 EDITING GUIDELINES
Background music: NOT ALLOWED. Use only the audio from the official assets.
No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
 REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔ High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔ English content only
✔ Minimum video length: 10 seconds
✔ Post to TikTok or Instagram Reels
✔ Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔ Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✔ Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔ Page audience should be mostly Tier 1-2 countries (30%+ Tier 3 may be removed)
✔ By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
 NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌ Footage not from the official content folder
❌ Posts with no free trial mention
❌ Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌ NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌ Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌ Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌ Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌ False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌ Mislabeling the content (a trailer is not "gameplay")
❌ Any added music
❌ AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌ Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌ Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌ Story boosting: story views do not count
❌ Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌ Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌ Removing the post before 30 days
❌ Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not the client. We are managing this campaign and are here to help.
